scope: Deterministic read-only reconnect-instability observer with bounded signal history and candidate backlog.

implemented.fingerprint: Stable source/type/failure-or-state identity; no random or wall-clock identity
implemented.deduplication: Equivalent fingerprints aggregate with first/last timestamps and occurrences
implemented.thresholding: Two reconnect attempts and 30 seconds downtime for signals; two observations for candidates
implemented.boundedRetention: 256 signals and 64 candidate aggregates by default
implemented.eventBus: Existing EventBus attach/publish surface; no replacement runtime

environment: Full suite used NUSA_CLOUD_STATE_DB_PATH=:memory: to avoid pre-existing persistent local SQLite identity state; no application files or external state were modified.
